$schema.description: JSON Schema for editor validation; ignored by the CLI.

tsconfig.description: tsconfig that type-checks the router, relative to this file.

router.description: Module exporting the router type, relative to this file.

routerType.description: Exported type name of the router.

namespace.description: Swift enum that holds every generated procedure.

output.description: Generated Swift file, relative to this file.

client.description: Generate TRPCClient and TRPCWire, which send each procedure over HTTP with tRPC's wire format. Set false to generate the types alone.

procedures.description: Dotted procedure paths to generate, such as `projects.list`.
